title: At the doctor's
setting: Your seven-year-old son Can has had a temperature since yesterday, so you take him to the family doctor.
goal: Describe a child's symptoms, reassure him, and understand the doctor's instructions.

cast.name: Doktor Bey
cast.why: A doctor you've just met: *siz*, and *Doktor Bey* to address him.

cast.name: Can
cast.why: Your own child: *sen*, always. *Siz* to him would sound like a joke.

nodes.en: Come in, sit down. What seems to be the problem?
nodes.note: *Şikâyet* is a complaint; at the doctor's it means your symptoms.

turn.prompt: Say your son has had a high temperature since yesterday.

replies.tr: Oğlumun dünden beri yüksek ateşi var.
replies.en: My son has had a high temperature since yesterday.
accept: Can'ın dünden beri yüksek ateşi var.
Oğlumun dünden beri çok ateşi var.

replies.tr: Benim dünden beri yüksek ateşim var.
replies.en: I've had a high temperature since yesterday.
replies.why: That's **your** temperature. It's your son's: *Oğlumun ateşi var*.

replies.en: My son high temperature since yesterday.
replies.why: A temperature is something you have: *Oğlumun ateşi var*, with the genitive, the possessive and *var*.

nodes.tr: Sizin mi? Ama hasta olan Can, değil mi?
nodes.en: Yours? But it's Can who's ill, isn't it?

turn.prompt: Apologise, and say it's your son who has the temperature.

replies.en: Yes, sorry. My son has a temperature.
Yes, sorry. Can has a temperature.

nodes.tr: Geçmiş olsun. Başka bir şikâyeti var mı? Öksürüyor mu?
nodes.en: I'm sorry to hear it. Anything else? Is he coughing?

turn.prompt: Say he coughs a lot at night and isn't eating. Or say it's only the temperature.

replies.tr: Geceleri çok öksürüyor ve hiçbir şey yemiyor.
replies.en: He coughs a lot at night, and he isn't eating anything.
accept: Geceleri çok öksürüyor. Hiçbir şey yemiyor.
Gece çok öksürüyor ve yemek yemiyor.

replies.en: No, it's only the temperature.
I cough a lot at night.

nodes.tr: Bir bakalım. Can, ağzını açar mısın? Aaa de!
nodes.en: Let's have a look. Can, will you open your mouth? Say aah!

turn.prompt: Encourage Can: tell him to open his mouth, it won't hurt.

replies.en: Come on, darling, open your mouth. It won't hurt.
Come on, open your mouth. It won't hurt.
Come on, darling, open my mouth. It won't hurt.

nodes.en: But am I going to have an injection? I'm scared!

turn.prompt: Ask the doctor whether he'll give Can an injection.

replies.en: Doctor, are you going to give him an injection?
Doctor, are you going to give him an injection?
Can, are you going to give an injection?
replies.why: That asks **Can** whether he'll give an injection. Ask the doctor, with *siz*: *İğne yapacak mısınız?*

react.en: Can's going to give it? No, no!

nodes.tr: Hayır, iğne yok, merak etme Can. Bir şurup yazıyorum: günde üç kez, yemekten sonra.
nodes.en: No, no injection, don't worry, Can. I'm prescribing a syrup: three times a day, after meals.

turn.prompt: Ask how many days he should take it, or what to do if the fever doesn't go down.

replies.en: How many days should he take it?
What should we do if his temperature doesn't go down?
How many times a day?
replies.why: He's just told you: *günde üç kez*, three times a day.

nodes.tr: Bir hafta. Ateşi düştükten sonra da bitirin, yarıda bırakmayın.
nodes.en: A week. Finish it even after the fever has gone; don't stop halfway.

turn.prompt: Ask whether he can go to school tomorrow.

replies.en: Can he go to school tomorrow?
Can you go to school tomorrow?
replies.why: *Gidebilir misin?* asks the doctor himself, and with *sen*. About Can: *Okula gidebilir mi?*

react.tr: Ben mi? Ben okulu çoktan bitirdim!
react.en: Me? I finished school long ago!

nodes.tr: Üç gün içinde düşmezse tekrar getirin. Gece çok yükselirse acile gidin.
nodes.en: If it doesn't go down within three days, bring him back. If it goes very high at night, go to the emergency department.

turn.prompt: Say you understand, and ask whether he can go to school tomorrow.

replies.en: I see. Can he go to school tomorrow?
accept: Tamam, anladım. Yarın okula gidebilir mi?

replies.en: Can you go to school tomorrow?
replies.why: *Gidebilir misin?* asks the doctor himself, and with *sen*. About Can: *Okula gidebilir mi?*

react.tr: Ben mi? Ben okulu çoktan bitirdim!
react.en: Me? I finished school long ago!

nodes.tr: Ateşi düşene kadar evde kalsın, iki üç gün dinlensin.
nodes.en: He should stay at home until the fever has gone, and rest for two or three days.

turn.prompt: Tell Can the news: a few days without school! Or thank the doctor.

replies.tr: Duydun mu, Can? Birkaç gün okul yok!
replies.en: Did you hear that, Can? No school for a few days!
accept: Duydun mu? Birkaç gün okul yok!
Can, duydun mu? Birkaç gün okula gitmiyorsun!

replies.tr: Duydunuz mu, Can? Birkaç gün okul yok!
replies.en: Did you hear that, Can? No school for a few days!
Thank you very much, Doctor.

nodes.end: Can has his syrup and a few days off school, and he's delighted.

nodes.en: You're welcome. Get well soon, Can!
nodes.end: Can has a syrup for a week, and stays at home until the fever has gone.

phrases.en: What seems to be the problem?

phrases.note: Someone's temperature: the genitive, the possessive, then *var*.

phrases.en: Come on, darling, open your mouth. It won't hurt.
phrases.note: *Canım*, my dear, is the warmest everyday endearment.

phrases.en: Are you going to give an injection?
Three times a day, after meals
What should we do if the fever doesn't go down?
